title: Fleet Account Uplift on Out-of-Area Tows
content:
Vehicles on a Crestline Fleet Account roster receive an uplift on the allowance for an out-of-area tow under Road Hazard Protection.

**Tow fleet uplift.** A vehicle whose latest roster enrollment entry has no later removal entry, on a Crestline Fleet Account in status active whose program carries the Crestline national fleet price file, adds 15 USD to the tow allowance; such a vehicle on an active fleet account whose program has no national price file adds 10 USD; any other vehicle adds nothing.

| Vehicle | Added to the tow allowance |
|---|---|
| open roster enrollment, active account, program with the national price file | 15.00 |
| open roster enrollment, active account, program without it | 10.00 |
| removed after its latest enrollment, never enrolled, or account not active | nothing |
